description: Developing biomaterials for advanced bleeding control & wound management applications post-trauma & surgery. Just finished human study for our hemostatic material, which stops bleeding in under a minute & is now nearing market launch.
problem_statement: Uncontrolled bleeding in hospital, military, and civilian life settings is a global public health problem, claiming more than 6 million lives annually, surpassing HIV, tuberculosis, and malaria combined. For instance, the Global Burden of Diseases study (GBD) demonstrates that road traffic injuries are among the leading causes of death and disability-adjusted life years (DALYs), accounting for 2.12% of total annual deaths and 2.87% of total DALYs. Countries like India contribute to this with nearly 700 road deaths daily, with 30% due to excessive blood loss. The USA records close to 40 million personal injury cases every year. Globally, over 700 million injuries are reported each year & reports suggest most of them could be saved if bleeding were stopped early.

team.justification: The founding team has strong domain expertise and complementary skills. Sabir Hossain, the CEO, has a background in biomaterials, while Dr. Mubeen Midda brings medical expertise. Dr. Devendra Verma adds significant R&D experience. The team has demonstrated execution capability by advancing from a master's project to a startup nearing market launch.

company_assessment.market_positioning: The company positions itself as a provider of advanced bleeding control solutions, differentiating through a novel biomaterial that outperforms existing biopolymers.
company_assessment.execution_capability: The team has successfully completed human studies and secured MOUs with the Indian Army, indicating strong execution capability.
company_assessment.strategic_vision: Miraqules has a clear strategic vision to expand from emergency and trauma care to consumer first-aid and other biomedical applications.
